README

jsk_3rdparty

ROS wrappers of third-party libraries and web services used in the JSK Lab (the University of Tokyo): speech synthesis and recognition, chat and cloud services, smart-home devices, PDDL planners, and libraries packaged for ROS. The packages marked ROS 2 below build from the same source for ROS 1 (catkin) and ROS 2 (ament); they switch by $ROS_VERSION, and jsk_ros1_ros2_compat (of jsk_common) keeps the code shared. The other packages are of ROS 1 only and carry an AMENT_IGNORE.

Packages

Package ROS 1 ROS 2 What it is
chaplus_ros ✓ ✓ Chat with the chaplus, A3RT Talk or mebo dialogue services
emotion_analyzer ✓ ✓ Emotions of a text or a voice by the Hume AI API
gdrive_ros ✓ ✓ Uploading files to Google Drive
google_chat_ros ✓ ✓ Sending and receiving messages of Google Chat
influxdb_store ✓ ✓ Storing topics (battery, joint states, network, robot pose) into InfluxDB, to be shown on Grafana
jsk_power_switching_tools ✓ ✓ Power cycling USB devices: USB-serial troubleshooter, USB PPPS hubs
nfc_ros ✓ ✓ Reading NFC tags
respeaker_ros ✓ ✓ Driver of the ReSpeaker Mic Array v2.0: audio, sound direction, voice activity
ros_speech_recognition ✓ ✓ Speech recognition by the Python SpeechRecognition library (Google, Google Cloud, Vosk, Sphinx, …)
rospatlite ✓ ✓ Driver of the PATLITE signal tower (network)
rosping ✓ ✓ ICMP ping to hosts, as a topic
sesame_ros ✓ ✓ Locking and unlocking the Sesame smart lock
switchbot_ros ✓ ✓ Controlling SwitchBot devices by the SwitchBot API
voicevox ✓ ✓ VOICEVOX: Japanese text-to-speech, for sound_play
zdepth, zdepth_image_transport ✓ ✓ Zdepth depth image compression, as an image_transport plugin
aques_talk ✓   AquesTalk2: Japanese text-to-speech
google_cloud_texttospeech ✓   Google Cloud Text-to-Speech for sound_play
voice_text ✓   HOYA VoiceText (ReadSpeaker) text-to-speech
julius, julius_ros ✓   Julius speech recognition engine and its ROS interface
webrtcvad_ros ✓   Voice activity detection of an audio topic by webrtcvad
dialogflow_task_executive ✓   Dialogue by Google Dialogflow, launching apps by it
ros_google_cloud_language ✓   Google Cloud Natural Language API
rostwitter ✓   Tweeting from ROS
opt_camera ✓   Driver of the OPT NM33 omnidirectional camera
downward, ff, ffha, lpg_planner ✓   PDDL planners
bayesian_belief_networks, pgm_learner ✓   Bayesian belief networks, and their parameter estimation
assimp_devel, libcmt, libsiftfast, nlopt, osqp, slic ✓   Libraries packaged for ROS: assimp, CMT tracker, SIFT, NLopt, OSQP, SLIC superpixels
mini_maxwell ✓   Setting up the Mini Maxwell network emulator
collada_urdf_jsk_patch, laser_filters_jsk_patch ✓   Patched versions of collada_urdf and laser_filters
hark_jsk_plugins     Plugins of HARK (not a ROS package)
jsk_3rdparty ✓   The metapackage

The README of each package (linked above) lists its nodes, launch files, topics and parameters. Many of these packages are clients of web services or drivers of devices, so they need an API key, a credential file or the hardware: see the “Requirements” of each README.

Install

# ROS 1 noetic
sudo apt install ros-noetic-jsk-3rdparty
# ROS One (https://ros.packages.techfak.net)
sudo apt install ros-one-jsk-3rdparty
# ROS 2 (jazzy, kilted, lyrical, rolling): once released (see the badges above), per package, e.g.
sudo apt install ros-$ROS_DISTRO-voicevox

From source:

mkdir -p ~/ws/src && cd ~/ws/src
git clone https://github.com/jsk-ros-pkg/jsk_3rdparty.git
cd ~/ws
# ROS 2: the packages of ROS 1 only are skipped by their AMENT_IGNORE
rosdep install -y -r --from-paths src --ignore-src
colcon build --symlink-install
# ROS 1: rosdep also skips the packages with AMENT_IGNORE, so remove the markers in a ROS 1 workspace
find src/jsk_3rdparty -name AMENT_IGNORE -delete
rosdep install -y -r --from-paths src --ignore-src
catkin build

Note: in ROS 1 this repository contains non-catkin packages (pure-cmake directories such as osqp, libcmt, slic and zdepth), so use either catkin build or catkin_make_isolated. catkin_make will not work.

The README of each package (linked above) lists its nodes, launch files, topics and parameters. Many of these packages are clients of web services or drivers of devices, so they need an API key, a credential file or the hardware: see the “Requirements” of each README.

Install

# ROS 1 noetic
sudo apt install ros-noetic-jsk-3rdparty
# ROS One (https://ros.packages.techfak.net)
sudo apt install ros-one-jsk-3rdparty
# ROS 2 (jazzy, kilted, lyrical, rolling): once released (see the badges above), per package, e.g.
sudo apt install ros-$ROS_DISTRO-voicevox

From source:

mkdir -p ~/ws/src && cd ~/ws/src
git clone https://github.com/jsk-ros-pkg/jsk_3rdparty.git
cd ~/ws
# ROS 2: the packages of ROS 1 only are skipped by their AMENT_IGNORE
rosdep install -y -r --from-paths src --ignore-src
colcon build --symlink-install
# ROS 1: rosdep also skips the packages with AMENT_IGNORE, so remove the markers in a ROS 1 workspace
find src/jsk_3rdparty -name AMENT_IGNORE -delete
rosdep install -y -r --from-paths src --ignore-src
catkin build

Note: in ROS 1 this repository contains non-catkin packages (pure-cmake directories such as osqp, libcmt, slic and zdepth), so use either catkin build or catkin_make_isolated. catkin_make will not work.
